title: Agent Ops Inspired (SP Story Pack)
inspired_by: Cancelled GTA V Agent Trevor DLC (researched)

features.desc: Undercover/agency mission chain with intel gathering and extractions.
Target dossiers, evidence boards, and clue tracking.
Stealth routes, disguises, detection states and silent takedowns.
Gadget and loadout selection (scanners, jammers, non-lethal options).
Intel safehouse hub integrated with launcher/world UI.
Branching mission outcomes affecting timeline pocket state.
